name: ludo-arena
description: LUDO ARENA - Browser-hosted 2/4/6/8-player LAN multiplayer Ludo game

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=@ludo-arena/server" "npm run dev --workspace=@ludo-arena/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@ludo-arena/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=@ludo-arena/validation && npm run build --workspace=@ludo-arena/board-config && npm run build --workspace=@ludo-arena/game-engine && npm run build --workspace=@ludo-arena/web && npm run build --workspace=@ludo-arena/server
